events.title: Shri Krishna Janmashtami
events.description: Bhajan sandhya, jhanki darshan and midnight janmotsav aarti followed by panjiri and charnamrit prasad.

events.title: Shardiya Navratri – Navahn Parayan Path
events.description: Nine days of Shri Ramcharitmanas Navahn Parayan path every morning, with aarti and prasad. All devotees are welcome to join the path.

events.title: Sundarkand Path
events.description: Weekly Sundarkand path every Tuesday evening, followed by Hanuman Chalisa, aarti and prasad.

events.title: विजयादशमी – शोभा यात्रा
events.description: श्री राम दरबार की नगर में भव्य शोभा यात्रा, तत्पश्चात राम-रावण लीला एवं मंदिर में महाआरती।

events.title: शरद पूर्णिमा – खीर प्रसाद
events.description: ठाकुर जी का श्वेत वस्त्रों में विशेष श्रृंगार, पूर्ण चन्द्र की चाँदनी में भजन संध्या, तथा चाँदनी में रखी खीर का प्रसाद अर्द्धरात्रि के बाद वितरित किया जाएगा।

events.title: Kartik Maas Deepdan
events.description: Every evening during Kartik maas, devotees offer diyas at the mandir. Diyas and ghee are available at the mandir counter.

events.title: Deepawali Deepotsav
events.description: The whole mandir is lit with thousands of diyas. Lakshmi pujan, special aarti and distribution of mithai prasad.

events.title: Annakoot Mahotsav
events.description: Chhappan bhog is offered to Thakur Ji, followed by darshan of the annakoot and a bhandara for all devotees.

events.title: Shri Sita-Ram Vivah Mahotsav
events.description: Vivah Panchami celebration of the divine wedding of Shri Sita Ram ji: baraat, vivah utsav, bhajan and bhandara.

events.title: Makar Sankranti – Khichdi Bhandara
events.description: Til-gud prasad, daan and khichdi bhandara for all devotees on the occasion of Makar Sankranti.

events.title: Shri Ram Navami Janmotsav
events.description: Janmotsav of Prabhu Shri Ram at noon, with Ramcharitmanas path, badhai bhajan, special shringar and bhandara.

events.title: सत्संग
events.description: स्वामी श्रीराजेन्द्र दास देवाचार्य जी महाराज के श्रीमुख से सत्संग — झांसी।
